description: This is a PHP class implementing the VacancyAttachmentDecorator, which provides additional functionality (such as retrieving file content and setting vacancy references) for VacancyAttachment entities within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin.

classes.name: VacancyAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class providing additional methods for VacancyAttachment entities, including file content retrieval and vacancy association.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a VacancyAttachment object.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the file content from VacancyAttachment, reading from resource streams if necessary.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Returns the VacancyAttachment entity being decorated.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Sets the associated Vacancy entity on the VacancyAttachment by its ID.
